gaps.explanation: Re-read pp4, 8-11. Schedule 888,573 is 234,274 above the statement 654,299. Per fund: General: combining schedule p11 (printed p22), 11 department columns, Total disbursements 654,298 = detail General expenditure lines = statement p4 General column Total disbursements 654,298 (the statement's function lines add to 654,299, its own rounding). Bond: statement p4 Bond column prints '-' on every disbursement row and prints Bond 'Debt service (234,275)' under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (JSON other_financing, not disbursements[]). The Bond Fund budget-and-actual schedule p9 (printed p20) prints the same money among DISBURSEMENTS: Debt service - principal 187,909 + Debt service - interest 46,066 + Other 300 = 234,275 (detail lines, section expenditure as printed). 654,298 + 234,275 = 888,573 = schedule total. Nothing is counted twice and no fund column is missing: the report itself puts Bond debt service under disbursements on p9 and under other financing on p4. The General Fund budget schedule p8 (printed p19) is correctly not in detail (same money as p11). No fix.

Statement p6 (accrual, Water / Sewer / Nursing Home columns): Utility sales 178,430 + 223,057 = 401,487, Interest income 4,304 (Sewer) -> 405,791. Detail holds the proprietary budget-and-actual schedule p10 (printed p21, 'Actual (Budgetary Basis)', all proprietary funds in one column): Utility sales 399,199 + Interest income 4,304 = 403,503. 401,487 - 399,199 = 2,288 is the report's printed basis difference. Adding the p6 fund-column lines would count the utility money twice next to the printed p10 lines, and printed p10 lines are not removed, so no fix.

Statement p6: Total operating expenses Water 225,555 + Sewer 154,079 = 379,635 (incl. Depreciation and amortization 138,237) + Interest expense 7,018 + 24,934 = 31,951 -> 411,586. Budget schedule p10 (budgetary basis): Personnel expenses 65,987 + Operating expenses 173,076 + Debt service 159,249 = 398,312 (no depreciation; debt service is cash principal 132,092 + interest, cf. cash-flow p7). 411,586 - 398,312 = 13,274, a printed basis difference. No fix (same reason as revenue).
